Logistics & Supply Chain Management

  1. Home
  2. Careers
  3. Career Level
  4. Professionals
  5. Logistics & Supply Chain Management

Do you value being close to our and maybe soon you suppliers? Does corporate responsibility play an important role for you? And do you want to be backed by Gerresheimer in your job? 

  • Your playground is the whole supply chain – from the demand planning until the delivery to our clients.
  • Whatever you do: You follow our corporate responsibility guideline for a sustainable supply chain management – a principle and part of our philosophy and values.
  • The collaboration with our suppliers is defined by the Gerresheimer compliance program, our purchasing policy and procedures directives. No matter whether it is about environmental regulations or disposal management.
